test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Abhiyan was launched in 2014 on the birth anniversary of the Father of the Nation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swachh Bharat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Swachh Bharat**

 
 
• Swachh Bharat Abhiyan is a country-wide campaign initiated by the Government of India in 2014.
 
• It was initiated to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management.
 
• The campaign was officially launched on 2 October 2014 at Rajghat, New Delhi by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.</st
